meta.source: cursor.com/home computed styles, 2026-10-17 — values are desktop (root 16px; below 900px the root is 15px and every rem value scales by 0.9375)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every section, the fixed header and the hero sit on bg.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary ink: headings, body copy, nav links on bg and every card surface (14.3:1 light, 15.9:1 dark). Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: fg-02
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill and border.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Default card surface and footer ground. Code and inline-code background.

tokens.name: card-01
tokens.usage: Lightest card step; light hover for feature cards.

tokens.name: card-02
tokens.usage: Card hover state; active list row (e.g. sidebar row) background; card--bg-02 surface.

tokens.name: card-03
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill; disabled button fill; card--bg-02 hover.

tokens.name: card-04
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover fill. Deepest card step.

tokens.name: card-warm
tokens.usage: Warm-tinted card surface for editorial or highlight blocks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand amber. FILLS and marks: the accent CTA (vm-btn--accent), eyebrow squares, active toggles, highlights, cover blocks. Light theme: never as text (1.6:1 on bg). Dark theme: also fine as text and link color (11.1:1 on bg).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent buttons and marks.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (9.1:1 in both themes). Never white on amber.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text-safe amber for links (vm-btn-text) and highlighted words. 5.9:1 on bg and 5.0:1 on card-03 light; 11.1:1 on bg dark.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Amber at 20%: selection, highlighted table rows, promo strips, tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: text-sec
tokens.usage: Secondary text (fg at 60%): footer column headings, captions, meta, quaternary buttons. On bg/card 4.1:1 light (below 4.5 in the source, kept exact), 6.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-mid
tokens.usage: Mid text (fg at 50%): de-emphasized labels. 3.1:1 light, 4.7:1 dark — use at 18px+ or for non-essential text.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and list bullets (fg at 40%): timestamps, placeholders. Decorative only; 2.4:1 light.

tokens.name: fg-02-5
tokens.usage: fg at 2.5%: wash layered on card (card-02 composite).

tokens.name: fg-05
tokens.usage: fg at 5%: wash layered on card (card-03 composite).

tokens.name: border-01
tokens.usage: Default hairline (fg 2.5%): card ::before outline, secondary button border, prose code border.

tokens.name: border-02
tokens.usage: Visible divider (fg 10%): hr, card hover border, outline shadow, window inner rule.

tokens.name: border-02-5
tokens.usage: Ghost button border and bright borders (fg 20%).

tokens.name: border-03
tokens.usage: Strong border (fg 60%): secondary outline buttons, info marks.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Outline style: the solid 1px rule for page-frame rails, section dividers, plate borders and cell grids.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Outline style: 9px crosshair nodes where dividers meet the rails, the dot pattern, dashed hollow plates. Decorative; 2.4:1 light / 2.7:1 dark, so never for text.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Success, inserted lines in diffs, +N counts. Pair with a sign (+) or word, not hue alone.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Error, removed lines in diffs, −N counts. Pair with a sign (−) or word, not hue alone.

families.serif: "EB Garamond", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "URW Palladio L", P052, ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
families.system: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: type-2xl
styles.usage: Largest display. Statement numerals and campaign headlines.

styles.name: type-lg
styles.sample: The new way to build software.

styles.name: type-md-lg
styles.sample: Your coding agent for building ambitious software.

styles.name: type-md
styles.usage: Feature heading (h3) at md+ screens; lead paragraphs.

styles.name: type-base
styles.usage: Body copy, feature h3 on mobile, testimonials, footer links, buttons.

styles.name: type-base-bold
styles.usage: Rare emphasis inside body copy. The brand almost never bolds.

styles.name: type-sm
styles.usage: Nav links, eyebrow h2 labels, footer links at md+, small buttons.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Outline style: section labels above headings, plate headers, table heads. Set text-transform: uppercase, color text-sec.

styles.name: serif-body
styles.usage: Editorial/manifesto paragraphs in the research block, in text-sec-like ink (fg 55%).
styles.sample: We have much to learn, try, and build.

styles.name: serif-italic
styles.usage: Italic display accents inside product mockups (set font-style: italic).

styles.name: type-product-lg
styles.usage: In-product mockup body: chat panes, file names.

styles.name: type-product-base
styles.usage: In-product mockup default: sidebar rows, tool labels.

styles.name: type-product-base-medium
styles.usage: Product mockup titles and active rows.

styles.name: type-product-sm-medium
styles.usage: Product mockup small labels with emphasis.

styles.name: type-product-base-mono
styles.usage: Code, terminal and install commands inside mockups.

spacing.note: Two grids: g (horizontal, 10px unit = 0.625rem) and v (vertical rhythm, 22.4px unit = 1.4rem). Fractions of v are in twelfths.

tokens.name: g1
tokens.usage: Base gap: 24-col grid gap, stacked cards, spacing-md.

tokens.name: g1.5
tokens.usage: Nav link side padding; card--large/text padding; spacing-lg.

tokens.name: g2
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (header, sections, footer); spacing-xl.

tokens.name: v1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between hero copy and media.

tokens.name: v2
tokens.usage: Between grouped blocks; footer row gap.

tokens.name: v4.5
tokens.usage: Large bottom margin before closing rows.

tokens.name: v5
tokens.usage: Hero top padding (below the fixed header).

tokens.name: rule-w
tokens.usage: Outline style: width of every rule, rail and plate border.

tokens.name: node
tokens.usage: Outline style: crosshair node size and dot-pattern pitch.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Outline style: plates, cell grids, section frames and media in outline pages are square.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: THE card radius: cards, media frames, product window, inline code, btn-block.

shadow.note: The brand separates with surface steps and 1px fg-alpha hairlines, not shadows. Shadows appear only on flyouts and product mockups.

layout.note: Breakpoints and containers. Root font is 15px below 900px, 16px at 900px+.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Main page grid: 24 equal columns, gap g1.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: root 15→16px, button padding tightens, header 56→52px.
